notes.title: MOMO.EXE VR Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here!
Great news everyone! Our team fixed controller input on many devices (I believe it's true) and some other fixes:

• You change your language at start
• Fixed bug when you can grab objects when you pick an axe 
• Purple flashlight
• Fixed chair when you stand up (AGAIN)
• And other small bugs

We need tester to play game with valve index headset right now. 
If you find a bug or have suggestions or want to help with translation, join with discord server.

DISCORD SERVER [url=https://discord.gg/7pAJ8wm]https://discord.gg/7pAJ8wm[/url]
TWITTER [url=https://twitter.com/Dymchick1]https://twitter.com/Dymchick1[/url]

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: MOMO.EXE VR Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here!
Good new everyone! Our team added a whole [b]tutorial section [/b] and some cool features like 

• You can stand up from computer by pressing jump 
• Speed was decreased in dungeons 
• Fixed some spell mistakes
• Added picture tip in the MOMO.EXE 2 dungeon

We know that you can not play game with valve index headset right now. We will try to fix it in next updates (early next week)
If you find a bug or have suggestions or want to help with translation, join with discord server.
MOMO.EXE VR DISCORD SERVER [url=https://discord.gg/7pAJ8wm]https://discord.gg/7pAJ8wm[/url]

Enjoy the game!
